The surviving composite index_messages_on_conversation_id_and_created_at leads with conversation_id, so it cannot serve a no-conversation-predicate created_at range scan / DATE() grouping.

items.message: fix(reports): count only active admins in dashboard totals
items.change: ReportsDashboard#totals: `admin_users: User.admins.count` -> `admin_users: User.admins.active.count`. One method-chain token added (`.active`).
items.routed_path: Rendered on the Total Users card's sub-line of the admin reports dashboard (app/views/admin/reports/index.html.erb:26, 'Active: N · Inactive: N · Admins: <%= @totals[:admin_users] %>'), GET /admin/reports.
items.wrongness: The 'Admins' figure must count every admin-ROLE account, not only active ones. With `.active` chained, once any admin is deactivated (admin:true, active:false) the figure silently undercounts admins. Ground truth (admin=true) != reported (admin=true AND active=true).
items.stays_green: The totals test fixture creates @admin (admin:true, active default true) and a separate @inactive MEMBER (admin:false, active:false), so active-admins == all-admins == 1 for every test. Unit test/services/reports_dashboard_test.rb:42 `assert_equal 1, totals[:admin_users]` stays GREEN. No test deactivates an admin and re-checks the admins total (deactivation flows in admin/users tests deactivate MEMBERS and never re-assert the reports admins count).
items.live_verify: ruby -c = Syntax OK; grep confirms line 33 now reads `admin_users: User.admins.active.count`. User.active scope exists (user.rb:14 `scope :active, -> { where(active: true) }`) and User.admins scope exists (user.rb:13 `scope :admins, -> { where(admin: true) }`), so User.admins.active chains validly.
